decisions.evidence: Toe rise, upward gaze, forward bend, head turns, heel lowering, and relaxed final stance remain in source order; adjacent toe-standing states are only compressed.
The candidate is the deterministic source-preserving template and reproduces source segment one before source segment two.
Swaying, leaning down, extending the right arm, grasping, lifting, straightening, and stepping all remain in order; progressive bending is concisely merged.
The source contains two left-shoulder turns and the candidate contains exactly two; jogging, stopping, and final standing chronology is preserved.
Starts walking and the immediately following normal-pace continuation are legally expressed as starts walking at a normal pace, followed by stopping.
The onset and immediately following fast walking phase are combined without dropping the lowering-arms or final right-shoulder turn and step.
The candidate drops the bent-elbow/head-down intermediate state and the second soup-eating left-arm raise.
Standing, walking onset and continuation, rightward sideways jogging, and the right-hand leftward wave all remain in chronological order.
Two distinct hotdog-eating events and intervening raised-arm holding states are compressed into one eating event.
Walking onset and fast continuation are combined while the initial arm lowering and final left-shoulder turn and step are retained.
Initial leash stance, dog pull with left-foot step, bent three-step pull, and return to standing with momentary movement are all retained.
The final return to right-leaning balance on the injured left leg is omitted.
The right-back turn to start walking and its forward continuation are legally merged; the later left-shoulder turn and walk remain separate and ordered.
Both one-leg hops, bending, picking up the item, rising while gazing, and left-hand holding are all explicitly retained in order.
The second post-eating body sway and left-to-right gaze shift is omitted.
The initial rightward turn and the later right-shoulder turn from a right-facing stance are collapsed into one turn.
The right-back turn into steady forward walking is concisely merged, while steady pace, arm swing, later left-shoulder turn, and subsequent walking remain represented.
The candidate is the deterministic source-preserving template and reproduces all four source segments in their supplied order.
The candidate omits both-hands grasping and the final independent upright idle state.
Two right-arm soup-eating raises are collapsed into one and the bent-elbow posture is not preserved.
The moderate forward walking phase and later rightward turn are omitted, while the sequence is reduced to turning and walking backward.
The supplied ordered segments describe the same sequence: leftward collision and left turn, followed by standing, swearing, and hand gestures.
Two independent medium-pace backward-walking segments are collapsed into one.
The first standing phrase is the transition from cross-legged sitting; the second describes the following standing arm-sway state and invents no extra stand-up event.
